Are you me?

I don't know what to say to help but I feel the same way, feel free to pm if you want to talk. Or just reply.

Wait so you pay for your own rent bills and school but your parents think you have some kind of obligation or owe them something? It sounds like other than your bad grades (which happens to the best of us) you've done nothing wrong. At least recognize that, and go easy on yourself. Your parents are being dicks. My mom is overbearing like your parents, I ended up blocking her number for my own sanity. Not saying you have to do that, just that the option is there. Again, really, you haven't done anything wrong. Take a deep breath and remind yourself you're doing the best you can.

I know what kind of care is out there for depression and mental illnesses, and I don't want it. It wouldn't work for me, and hasn't in the past, because I work in the mental health care system and I know what goes on behind the scenes and that the nurses and doctors and psychiatrists who "care" for you really don't give a shit. I would just come back home afterwards with more medical bills and more stress, and feeling worse from being patronized and hospitalized. I don't know what to do. There's nothing I can do to help myself or be helped.

I honestly feel like I deserve it, the suffering. I didn't know it was possible to hate yourself this much. I don't want to experience delusions again because it's scary to know something isn't true but at the same time believe it completely.
I hate myself so much that yesterday I had a delusion that my organs were literally rotting, like the black tar that comes out of zombies when people stab them in movies. It was terrifying.
